name: Jágónak (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Jágónak (a green and blue shield with a bishop, a hatchet and ears of grain, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll inscribed JÁGÓNAK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jágónak arms with wreath and scroll
